case_info.description: Example demonstrating automatic y+ based boundary layer sizing for RANS simulation
case_info.notes: This example shows how to use target_yplus for automatic first layer thickness calculation

mesh._comment_feature: Set target_yplus to automatically calculate finalLayerThickness
mesh._comment_benefit: Ensures proper boundary layer resolution without manual estimation

boundary_layers._comment_target: Target y+ = 1.0 for low-Re RANS (k-omega SST)
boundary_layers._comment_alternatives: Use 30-100 for high-Re wall functions, 0.5-2.0 for LES
boundary_layers._comment_method: auto = uses geometry + typical cardiac output to estimate flow
boundary_layers._comment_velocity: e.g., 0.6 if you know typical aortic velocity (m/s)
boundary_layers._comment_length: e.g., 0.022 if you know inlet diameter (m)

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_layers: 5 layers typical for RANS to capture boundary layer
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_final: Will be AUTO-CALCULATED from target_yplus (ignore this value)

_comment_step1: 1. Mesh generation calculates finalLayerThickness from target_yplus
_comment_step2: 2. Logs show: Re, u_tau, calculated layer thickness, total BL thickness
_comment_step4: 4. Post-processing automatically computes actual y+ values
_comment_step5: 5. Verify actual y+ matches target (typically within 10-20%)
_comment_step6: 6. If needed, adjust target_yplus and regenerate mesh
